author: Matias Tassano, 2018
stage: local input denoising before colorization; no OCR, detection, translation or text rendering
reader_extension: Applied to Klein, Gemini and OpenAI inputs; MTU's API colorizers do not consume denoise_sigma. Default disabled for compatibility.
normalization: RGB preserved; odd dimensions edge padded; longest side limited to 1200 then restored as in MTU
